items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Because Bill Cassancho and his wife lived in Chattanooga, where I used to live.

ctx.x: Dutch. They called her Dutch. Oh, who was that? His mother. His mother. Oh, his mother. He used to call her Dutch. But he was supposed to have had a brother, I'd heard.
He had a brother, but his brother was a saxophone player. A saxophone player. Mm-hmm. Because Bill Cassancho and his wife lived in Chattanooga, where I used to live. They were from Chattanooga?
